name: Gold Token
oneLiner: GLDT is Gold DAO's fungible gold token: each token represents 0.01 grams of physical gold through locked GLD NFT backing.
collateral: GLD NFTs representing physical gold bars stored in Swiss vaults; GLDT is minted when GLD NFTs are locked in the swap canister at a ratio of 1 gram of GLD NFT backing for 100 GLDT
pegMechanism: Commodity redemption/swap model: 1 GLDT represents 0.01 grams of gold, and GLDT can be reverse-swapped into GLD NFTs when enough tokens are supplied to unlock the corresponding NFT denomination

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
reserveReview.rationale: Gold DAO describes GLDT as the gold-backed token issued through the GLD NFT swap route at 100 GLDT per gram of locked GLD NFT, with the underlying gold bars produced and stored in Switzerland and the vault audited on a recurring cycle. The reviewed composition therefore retains one aggregate 100% locked-gold-NFT category; bar-level weights, serial numbers, and current custody allocation are not publicly reconciled.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Gold DAO GLDT documentation and current swap/ledger control review
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The backing class is identified as locked GLD NFTs representing physical gold, but current bar inventory, serial-level allocation, and custody-provider shares are not disclosed in the reviewed sources.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: GLD NFTs map to specific physical gold bars with serial-level certificates stored in Swiss vaults, supporting bar-level segregation, and the issuer describes recurring independent vault audits (KPMG per the proof-of-reserves entry). The current primary pages do not name the vault operator, insolvency treatment, or rehypothecation terms.

mintAuthority.summary: GLDT is minted by the Gold DAO swap canister on the Internet Computer when users lock GLD NFTs at 100 GLDT per gram; the swap canister holds the GLDT ledger minting rights and is governed/upgradeable by the Gold DAO SNS.

controls.label: GLDT swap canister (minter)
controls.capDescription: The GLDT swap canister holds minting rights on the GLDT ledger and mints only when GLD NFTs are locked (100 GLDT per gram); reverse swaps burn GLDT and release NFTs, so supply is collateral-bounded by locked gold NFTs.
controls.evidence: The GLDT ICRC-1 ledger's icrc1 minting account is 6f6ua-hqaaa-aaaar-qairq-cai (ICRC API read 2026-07-20), which the GoldDAO/gold-dao canister_ids.json maps to the gldt_swap canister; the IC API shows its sole controller is the Gold DAO SNS root tw2vt-hqaaa-aaaaq-aab6a-cai. The swap canister mints GLDT only when GLD NFT gold certificates are locked (1/100 g per GLDT), so minting is bounded by gold deposits and cannot be raised administratively.

controls.capDescription: The Internet Computer SNS DAO is the controlling authority of the GLDT swap and ledger canisters and can upgrade their code; GLDT is issued and governed by the Gold DAO.

controls.evidence: The Internet Computer API identifies 6c7su... as the Gold DAO GLDT Ledger controlled by Gold DAO Root tw2vt.... Gold DAO Root is controlled by Gold DAO Governance tr3th..., and Governance is in turn controlled by Root, confirming the live SNS controller loop for ledger upgrades.

review.evidence: Gold DAO documentation describes GLDT minting via an SNS-controlled swap canister against locked GLD NFTs. Current Internet Computer API state confirms the GLDT ledger is controlled by Gold DAO Root and closes the Root/Governance controller loop. The public key-canister directory still does not identify the swap-canister principal that holds ledger minting rights. 2026-07-20 (Kimi P2 dc-2): the GLDT ledger minting account is the GLDT swap canister 6f6ua-hqaaa-aaaar-qairq-cai (ICRC API), controlled solely by the Gold DAO SNS root tw2vt-hqaaa-aaaaq-aab6a-cai (IC API) — the previously open swap-canister principal question is closed. Minting is bounded by locked GLD NFT gold deposits.
